pairs.question: Ergo et Deo non agimus gratias, non referimus laudes?
pairs.answer: Credo, quia agimus gratias, potest fieri, sed verbo tenus, sed in sinu: Deo privatim gratias agimus, nobis publice; Deo in labiis laudem tribuimus, nobis et in labiis et in corde.
pairs.derivation: Authorial objection-and-reply. Dropped the framing tag 'Sed fortasse respondetur mihi:' that narrates the imagined objection; the interrogative itself is verbatim. Answer begins at 'Credo' (the operative reply) and ends at the full stop after 'in corde' (one sentence); what follows ('Ecce hoc est quod incurvatum saepius erigit inimicum...') turns to general elaboration and is excluded.
